# Core combined acceptance — 2026-10-06

`source.vdoc.json` is an independent QA sample derived from the existing core-system acceptance sample. It includes multilingual text, 36 table body rows, 18 vertical merges, an embedded valid image, explicit page break, and heading/link format overrides. No user document was modified.

The page imported it as document `e858f4e0-a591-4626-9c45-e37fb84a53ca`. The actual workflow changed BEFORE to AFTER, converted the first bullet item to an ordered list, applied cell-local background/italic, and resized the image to 240×120 with new alt text. Each operation was undone/redone using the toolbar with full document equality checks. Reopening and reloading preserved the final content.

`downloaded.vdoc.json` and `downloaded.docx` are immutable bytes actually downloaded from the page's File menu and Word download link, then copied here from Downloads. They are not regenerated by tests. JSON was reimported through the file chooser with exact document equality. Word reimport initially exposed a pre-existing paragraph matching bug: invisible vertical-merge continuation paragraphs consumed a later real blank/page-break paragraph. The importer was fixed; the same unchanged DOCX bytes were reimported again. Verified document `7aad1941-0c6c-49ad-9803-33183b2dc2ce`, named QA core batch Word verified 2026-10-06, retained its explicit final page break.

Word's actual page preview: A4 portrait, 5 pages; rows 01–08 / 09–18 / 19–28 / 29–36 on pages 1–4, each exactly once; repeated headers on those four pages, image and local cell formatting visible; FINAL PAGE CHECK and its text alone on page 5. Closing preview preserved the complete document JSON. This is browser preview evidence, not a newly printed Safari PDF or desktop Microsoft Word visual acceptance.

`core-batch-delivery.test.ts` verifies these downloaded files; `word-paragraph-matching.test.ts` covers the matching regression and leading/trailing/consecutive breaks through two roundtrips.

## Larger backup evidence

Run `node tests/fixtures/core-batch-20261006/generate-large.mjs` to generate `/private/tmp/vdoc-large-core-batch.vdoc.json`: 2,500 blocks, 2,485,000 UTF-16 text units, 4,840,129 UTF-8 bytes. Source imported through the page, downloaded from File menu, refreshed and reimported through the page. All document JSON compared exactly across reload/reimport; source text runs and block types also match the actual downloaded file. After reimport, appending END-CHECK to the last paragraph left all other blocks unchanged; one toolbar Undo restored the entire document. This tests one 4.8 MB sample, not a maximum size/performance guarantee or quota/force-quit acceptance.

Actual larger download: `/Users/ph.qian/Downloads/QA large backup 2500 2026-10-06.vdoc.json`, 6,594,191 bytes (hydrated defaults/IDs and formatted JSON), SHA-256 `a61e20e5330305c473c7e357283e65a898f67456ca8cb34eccb315219f4ca26a`. The large file is kept in Downloads rather than duplicated here; the generator preserves reproducibility.
